title: Immutable Noncanonical Document Snapshot
$comment: Snapshot provenance only, not verification or authority. record_hash is SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify of the payload reconstructed in property order: version, kind, task_id, source_path, source_content_hash, source_bytes, captured_at, purpose, archive_path. No whitespace. Lowercase sha256: digest. Raw preimage and record filenames are independently bound by the verifier. Source identity is historical; current source bytes need not still exist or match.
